content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
FfcCustomerId
CID provided to the Falcon Forensics Collector via command line argument.
FfcAgentId
AgentId either borrowed from the sensor or computed by Falcon Forensics Collector touniquely identify the host endpoint.
FfcCollectionId
16-byte UUID that Uniquely identifies a Falcon Forensics Collection.
FfcExecutablePath
Path to Forensics Collector executable.
FfcExecutableName Name of Forensics Collector executable.
FfcVersion
Forensics Collector version string.
ComputerName
Name of the device on which sensor is running.
FfcOutputFileName
Path to output file written by Forensics Collector.
FfcPlatform
Enum representing the platform from which a collection originates.
Values:
FFC_PLATFORM_LINUX (0)
FFC_PLATFORM_DARWIN (1)
FFC_PLATFORM_WINDOWS (2)
FFC_PLATFORM_UAC (3)
PhysicalAddress
The MAC address of the device
LocalAddressIP4
LocalAddressIP6
DomainName
The actual domain name being queried in this request.
UserIsAdmin
Set to TRUE if this user is a local admin.
IsVirtualMachine
Event is from a virtual machine.
FfcCollectionTag
User-assigned tag for a forensics collection.
